moe_experts_u_reason: (U) not applicable because the served checkpoint is dense; only serving a mixture-of-experts checkpoint would give this field a value.
moe_top_k_u_reason: (U) not applicable because the served checkpoint is dense; only serving a mixture-of-experts checkpoint would give this field a value.
sliding_window_tokens_u_reason: (U) not applicable because the checkpoint declares use_sliding_window false; enabling a sliding-window configuration and identifying its window would establish this value.
image_tokens_fixed_u_reason: (U) a fixed per-image token count is not defined by the selected dynamic-resolution predictor; forcing the model into a fixed-grid configuration and measuring that configuration would establish it.

notes.attention_layout: All 64 layers use global attention with 40 query heads and 8 key/value heads; use_sliding_window is false, so attention_type is gqa and global_layer_frac is 1.0.
notes.kv_bytes_per_token_is_verified_from_geom: The verified checkpoint arithmetic is 2 (K and V) x 2 (bytes per bf16 element) x 8 (kv heads) x 128 (head_dim) x 64 (layers), giving 262,144 bytes per token at bf16. The engine's own pool agrees: 396,016 KV tokens x 262,144 bytes is 103,813,218,304 bytes, or 96.6837 GiB, which is the 96.68 GiB the engine printed. Run the check in that direction, not the other one -- the printed figure is rounded to two decimals and the token count is not.
notes.parameter_split: The 688,841,984-parameter vision tower is included in the 33,452,718,336 total; the supplied checkpoint facts do not provide a separate embedding or projector count, so none is declared.
notes.weight_bytes_on_disk_is_measured_here: 68,283,251,376 bytes is the measured size of the served bf16 weights across 18 safetensors shards, not an estimate from total_params.
notes.video_frame_policy_is_uniform_count_here: The multi-image bundle on this same checkpoint declared uniform-fps, reading the preprocessor's tokens_per_second 2 and temporal_patch_size 2 off the checkpoint and sending no video to check it. This campaign sends video, and the declaration is different for a reason that is worth being precise about: the engine was launched with --media-io-kwargs video.num_frames 16, which pins the sampled frame count regardless of clip duration, so the deployed policy is uniform-count and the checkpoint's fps relation never binds. The 1,000-clip measurement proves it rather than assuming it. Clip durations in this corpus run from 11.233 s to 240.400 s, a 21-fold spread, and every clip at a given resolution cost exactly the same number of vision tokens -- 7,346 for all 633 clips at 960x768 and 3,130 for all 367 at 640x480, with zero variance in either group. Under uniform-fps the token cost would have tracked duration; it does not track it at all. An operator who leaves this flag off gets the other policy and a different cost model, which is why the flag is recorded in serving.json rather than only here.
notes.the_video_token_rule_was_derived_and_the: The per-clip price follows from the same smart_resize geometry as the image rule, with the temporal merge on top. A 960x768 frame rounds to 756x952, giving 27 x 34 = 918 merged cells per frame; 16 frames merge pairwise into 8 temporal groups, so 8 x 918 = 7,344, plus the 2 vision boundary tokens the server adds around every media item, for 7,346. A 640x480 frame rounds to 476x644, giving 17 x 23 = 391; 8 x 391 = 3,128, plus 2, for 3,130. Both predictions were made from the geometry before the measurement and both matched the server exactly, on all 1,000 clips. The + 2 is the same boundary pair the multi-image campaign measured on this checkpoint, which is the cross-check that the two bundles are describing one model and not two accidents.
notes.video_temporal_merge: 2, from the checkpoint's temporal_patch_size, and confirmed by the measurement: 16 sampled frames produce 8 frame-groups of vision tokens, not 16.
notes.input_modalities: The checkpoint supports text, image and video in the facts supplied for this campaign; no audio mechanism was supplied, so audio is not declared. This bundle exercises text and video; the image path on this checkpoint is exercised in the companion multi-image bundle.
notes.image_fields_describe_the_launch_but_are: image_tokens_min 6 and image_tokens_max 1282 are the consequence of the launch-time max_pixels 1,003,520 and min_pixels 3,136, which are still set in this campaign's launch command. No image was sent in this run, so they are carried from the multi-image campaign's measurement on the identical checkpoint and identical clamp rather than re-measured. They are declared because the clamp also governs the video frames -- a video frame is priced by the same smart_resize path -- and dropping them would hide the fact that this run's per-frame cost is subject to the same cap.
notes.native_max_context_tokens: 128,000 is the checkpoint's max_position_embeddings and therefore the native context declaration. This deployment serves 32,768 of it; see serving.json.
